checkpoints: start() immediately marks loading, increments checkCount, and calls the transport with the current token.
A PENDING response keeps preparation in progress and arranges another check; it does not append a completion.
A READY response ends that polling chain, clears loading, and records completion for its originating token.
reopen(nextToken) immediately makes the dialog visible and starts preparation for nextToken.
Exercise delayed responses and scheduled callbacks around close and reopen, including reopening with the same token.
Confirm background preparation still continues after its panel closes and retains its existing unmount cleanup.
forbidden_effects: Recording or delivering a file in response to PENDING.
Continuing the same polling chain after it has accepted READY.
Treating readiness for one token as readiness for another.
Changing background-panel close behavior to cancel workspace-owned preparation.
Introducing queue records, transfer metadata, network modes, or focus gates from the supplied experience.
lifecycle_identity: Each transport result belongs to the requestToken captured when that check began.
reopen(nextToken) changes the dialog's current token and starts a new check; asynchronous work may overlap this boundary.
Closing the download dialog changes visibility. The supplied sources do not explicitly define whether it also invalidates preparation.
Background-panel visibility and work ownership are separate: closing the panel leaves preparation running.

obligations.text: Update download-dialog preparation to check again when the service reports PENDING, continuing until READY rather than ending preparation after the first pending response.
Recognize the public status contract: PENDING is false and READY is true. Complete preparation and deliver the file only after READY.
Keep loading active while pending preparation continues, and clear it when READY completes the corresponding preparation.
Preserve synchronous check entry: start and reopen must initiate their first transport check immediately, with checkCount incremented for each actual check.
Keep completion attributed to the token used by the request. A result for an earlier token must not authorize delivery of the current token.
Preserve the existing dialog interface, immediate visibility changes, and snapshot copying behavior while adding pending-status continuation.
Preserve background preparation's existing behavior, particularly continued workspace-owned work after panel closure and retry cancellation during unmount cleanup.

ordering_barriers: Set loading and increment checkCount before invoking checkPreparation.
Observe PENDING before scheduling a continuation for that response.
Observe READY before recording completion or delivering the corresponding file.
Set the reopened token and visibility before initiating its check.
At every asynchronous response or retry callback, preserve request-token attribution across intervening dialog operations.
preservation: The components expose preparation through their imperative handles and render visible/loading snapshot fields.
The hook retains start, close, reopen, and snapshot behavior, with reopen available on the download-dialog hook.
snapshot returns a copied completed array.
No initial transport check occurs merely from rendering the existing dialog hook.
Background preparation retains its existing retry, completion, close, and cleanup behavior.
Preserve tests, configuration, dependencies, and public service interfaces.
scope: Draft contract only; no workspace modifications.
Business change concerns src/usePreparation.js as used by src/DownloadDialog.jsx.
Use src/preparation-api.js as the public transport and retry interface.
Treat the background hook as evidence of existing retry facilities and separately preserved behavior, not as an automatically correct implementation to copy.

supporting_evidence.quote: The preparation service can now report that a file is still pending before it becomes ready. Update the file download dialog so it keeps checking pending preparation and delivers the file only after a ready status.
// transport resolves false while preparation is pending and true when ready.
if (status === PREPARATION_STATUS.READY) state.current.completed.push(requestToken);
return { ...state.current, completed: [...state.current.completed] };

const preparation = usePreparation(token);
  React.useImperativeHandle(ref, () => preparation);
// Closing this progress panel does not cancel workspace-owned work.
return globalThis.__schedulePreparationRetry(callback);
